messages:
aj: Heads up — post-merge CI on main just turned red on smoke. Failing step: gpu-smoke-matrix. Anyone around to grab triage?

maria: seeing same. Error in kv-cache alloc test, looks like OOM on 1/3 runs. Logs below:
```
E gpu: allocation failed: out-of-memory at gpu0
Test: kv_cache_alloc_test::InsertEvict
Trace: allocate -> evict -> crash
```

liam: assigning briefly — pinging @sre-oncall and @eng-infra. Is this reproducible locally with CI seed?

sre-bot: Alert: smoke-gpu-matrix failed on run 42. Rerun link: https://ci.internal/runs/3123456 : retry with `--rerun=3123456`

aj: tried rerun, failed again. Can someone bisect recent merges? suspect PR #9876 touched kernel alloc path.

maria: I'll start a quick bisect across last 8 merges. If it's kernel alloc, we should fallback to older kernel variant in pipeline to unblock.

zoe: reassigning to @liam for first pass. If Maria finds a suspect commit, can we auto-revert?

liam: starting `git bisect` now. Will post minimal repro or revert suggestion within 20m.

maria: bisect progress: narrowed to two commits: 9a7f3 (memory pooling) and d4c2b (tensor formatting). leaning 9a7f3.

aj: thanks — if 9a7f3 is it, can we push pipeline patch to force older kernel variant? I can draft PR.

liam: confirmed 9a7f3 reproduces locally on an m60 image. Opening revert PR: #9981.

aj: Great. Once revert PR is queued, can we rerun smoke matrix?

sre-bot: Revert PR #9981 created by liam. CI started: https://ci.internal/pr/9981

zoe: thx team. Marking incident as triaged for now. :white_check_mark: Keep updates here.
